templates.title: 1. Screening & Initial Job Pitch
templates.body: Hi {{candidate_name}}, this is {{recruiter_name}} from OAKsphere Connect regarding your application for the *{{job_title}}* role at *{{client_name}}* (Salary: {{salary_range}}). We are currently shortlisting candidates for upcoming interview rounds. Are you available for a quick 2-minute discussion today?

templates.title: 2. Interview Call Letter & Venue / Maps Link
3. Morning-of-Interview Attendance Confirmation
templates.body:
Good morning {{candidate_name}}! ☀️ Quick reminder for your scheduled interview today for *{{job_title}}* at *{{client_name}}* at {{interview_time}}.

Please reply with *"CONFIRMED"* so the client HR panel reserves your spot. If you face any commute delays, call me immediately on {{recruiter_phone}} so we can adjust your slot.

templates.title: 4. Post-Interview Status & Follow-up
templates.body: Hi {{candidate_name}}, how was your interview with {{client_name}} for {{job_title}} today? Please share your experience and the rounds completed so we can coordinate feedback with the HR manager. You can reply here or call me on {{recruiter_phone}}.

templates.title: 5. Document Checklist for Joining
templates.body:
Congratulations {{candidate_name}} on clearing the interview for *{{job_title}}* at *{{client_name}}*! 🎊

To release your official Offer Letter and initiate onboarding, please share scanned copies/photos of:
1. Aadhaar Card (both sides)
2. PAN Card
3. Highest Educational Degree/Marksheet
4. Last 3 Months Salary Slips (if experienced)
5. Relieving / Experience Letter
6. Bank Passbook or Cancelled Cheque

Please send these over WhatsApp or email by 5:00 PM today.
